description: List recent social-connect (OAuth) attempts in a workspace, including failed ones, with the platform, initiator, outcome, and error code. Requires workspace_id. Useful for diagnosing why a client could not connect an account; aidelly_list_accounts lists the accounts that did connect. Read-only.
